description: Truck travel times on freeway facilities in Germany in 2019 based on FCD is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Marian Schlott, Lateef Abdul (University of Wuppertal). The datasets enable a temporal and spatial analysis regarding truck travel times on German highways for the year 2019. You can find further information in the attached method report. Coverage: national (DE); the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
